correctness.rationale: For each index-shift wave, the alphabet update forces increments 0 or 1. Horizontal stripes give exactly 3b_i successor neighbors. Diagonal stripe geometry yields N_i=2b_i+(b_i xor b_{i+1})+b_{i-2}b_{i-1}, a necessary-and-sufficient four-symbol criterion. The explicit eight-state transfer matrix and its characteristic polynomials are computed with exact integer arithmetic in the embedded verifier; the eigenvalues then give entropy via standard SFT spectral theory. The color lift is three-to-one, so does not change entropy. The axial period count is an exact trace of I+P, and zeta is its determinant reciprocal. Separate brute-force two-dimensional updates for all period widths 3–8 and thresholds 1–8 agree; such finite checks are corroboration, not proof.
